# console-1.2 run gpu166: GPU core at 166 MHz instead of 222
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 2, group hardware, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# Fixed picture size, or the ladder hides the answer: use gpufix as its reference. A PSVshell profile with the GPU locked ignores the request: run without one, and the `clocks:` line must report GPU 166. If the GPU time per frame ([lane] gpu, [rt] GPU busy) grows by the full 222/166 = 1.34, the core (shaders, fill) is the limit and memory is not; a smaller growth is the share spent waiting on memory. Also proves 222 is real: a getter is not a measurement.
# ---- route and logging: the same in every run ----
MSC_INPUT_SCRIPT=ux0:data/mscharged-perf-test/tour.txt
MSC_FRAME_TIMING=300
MSC_LAT=1
MSC_WATCH=1
MSC_WATCH_EVERY=600
MSC_VITA_CLOCK_POLICY=max
# ---- under test: nothing here means the default ----
MSC_VITA_GPU_MHZ=166
MSC_DYNRES=0
